title: Etale residue triple unit refinement
statement: Let $R$ be a commutative ring, $p$ a prime, $K$ a field, and $\chi:\kappa(p)\to K$ a field homomorphism. For a triple $t=(B,\alpha,q,\phi)$ in [def-weil-pbc-etale-residue-triples] and $f\in B\setminus q$, there are a triple $s=(B_s,\alpha_s,q_s,\phi_s)$ and a morphism $a:t\to s$ whose underlying ring map sends $f$ to a unit of $B_s$.

proof.text: Write beta:B -> K for the residue map of t. Its kernel is q, since the residue-field embedding is injective. Thus beta(f) is nonzero and is a unit in K. The universal property extends beta to B[1/f] -> K.

The kernel q_s of the extended map is prime, pulls back to q, and hence lies over p. The induced injection B[1/f]/q_s -> K extends to its fraction field, giving phi_s. Compatibility follows by restriction to R. Spec(B[1/f]) -> Spec(B) is the principal open immersion, hence is etale by lem-weil-pbc-etale-composition-cancellation(1); composing with Spec(B) -> Spec(R) is etale by clause (2), so this is a triple s and the localization map is a morphism t -> s. The image of f is invertible by construction.

proof_origin: Stacks Project Tags 04GN and 04GP, with kernel and residue-field constructions; second reading by D2, 2026-10-12.

lean.statement:
theorem etaleResidueTriple_unit_refinement
    (R : CommRingCat.{u}) (p : Spec R) (K : Type u) [Field K]
    (χ : (Spec R).residueField p ⟶ CommRingCat.of K)
    (t : EtaleResidueTriples R p K χ) (f : t.B) (hf : f ∉ t.q.asIdeal) :
    ∃ (s : EtaleResidueTriples R p K χ) (a : t ⟶ s),
      IsUnit (((etaleResidueTriplesRingDiagram R p K χ).map a).hom f)
